clips.title: The story
paras: The Adventurer is a local errand given by Mountaineer Thalos at the southern gate of Dun Morogh. Before sending travelers through the mountain tunnel toward Kharanos, Thalos asks them to carry a bundle of supplies to Eric Brighthammer, a newcomer camped just outside the village.

Guarding the high passes and tunnels between Coldridge Valley and the broader snowy expanses of Dun Morogh is demanding work for the Ironforge Mountaineers. Stationed at the border gate, Mountaineer Thalos keeps an eye out for both local dangers and travelers passing along the beaten trail. When word reaches the post about a lone adventurer arriving near Kharanos, Thalos uses trusted passersby to haul necessary supplies onward to support newcomers venturing into the frozen crags.

The road descending from the southern pass winds into the settlement of Kharanos, the primary hub for dwarven craft and travel in central Dun Morogh. Eric Brighthammer has recently established himself just on the outskirts of the village. By delivering the Mountaineers' bundle of provisions to him, travelers help establish a vital link between the outlying ridge sentries and those actively wandering the wilderness.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you brave that tunnel.
My mountaineers have reported an adventurer that's shown up just outside of Kharanos. Could you deliver these supplies to him?

clips.title: Progress

clips.title: Completion
paras: You say these are from the mountaineers? Aye, I could use them. Thank you, priest.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
